_comment: Static code-entry seeds for bank $3e: stranded code heads between its record/palette tables. Flat = 0x3e*0x4000 + (cpu-0x4000). $43db/$440b/$4421 are byte-identical relocated copies of bank $3b's GetCellIndexFromCursorPtr ($43cb) and ClearWram3Row64 ($43fb) plus its ld a,$00 twin -- same instruction stream, verified byte-for-byte, just unreferenced in this bank.
